Metrics API¶

Metrics for echo cancellation, noise cancellation, and system identification.

The functions in this module intentionally avoid audio-specific dependencies. They operate on NumPy arrays and are useful for synthetic benchmarks where the clean target or true echo component is known.

lattice_dsp.metrics.echo_metrics(microphone, enhanced, clean_target, *, frame_length=1024, epsilon=1e-12)[source]

Compute synthetic echo-cancellation metrics.

clean_target is the desired signal that should remain after echo/noise cancellation. In real recordings it is usually unavailable; in synthetic benchmarks it lets us compute ERLE and MSE improvement consistently.

Parameters:

  • microphone (Any)

  • enhanced (Any)

  • clean_target (Any)

  • frame_length (int)

  • epsilon (float)

Return type:

EchoMetrics

lattice_dsp.metrics.erle_db(echo_or_input_error, residual_error, *, epsilon=1e-12)[source]

Return echo-return-loss enhancement in dB.

In synthetic experiments, echo_or_input_error is usually the microphone signal minus the clean near-end/noise target before cancellation. The residual_error is the enhanced output minus the same clean target after cancellation. Positive values mean echo/error power was reduced.

Parameters:

  • echo_or_input_error (Any)

  • residual_error (Any)

  • epsilon (float)

Return type:

float
